embeds.title: ts2wasm 開発ループレポート

fields.name: 🎯 目的
fields.value: Issue 060 coverage ramp: expand the stored test262 reference window from limit 3000 to limit 3500 and classify any newly visible unknown-unsupported cases.

fields.name: 🔄 実施内容
fields.value:
- Ran the assigned test262 limit-3500 detail coverage command.
- Stored the limit-3500 JSON artifact in `artifacts/coverage/results/test262.json`.
- Updated `artifacts/coverage/reference-coverage-matrix.md`.
- Recorded evidence in issue 060, `current-state.md`, and the child report.

fields.name: 🧠 判断と根拠
fields.value: The limit-3500 detail run returned zero `unknown-unsupported` cases. The JSON artifact rerun completed with `executed=3500`, `unsupported=3500`, and `blocked=0`, so no classifier or follow-up issue changes were needed.

fields.name: ⚠️ 詰まり・ロス
fields.value: Discord reporting was deferred because `DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL` is not configured in the environment or `.env`.

fields.name: 📉 リスク
fields.value: Issue 060 remains open because the broader unknown-unsupported exhaustion work is not complete, and the assigned reference root still lacks the TypeScript checkout required for exact tsc validation from that root.

fields.name: ➡️ 次にやるべきこと
fields.value: Continue the reference-backed ramp beyond test262 limit 3500 and classify any newly visible unknown-unsupported cases.

fields.name: 📌 完了 / 追加
fields.value:
- PROGRESS: issue 060 test262 limit-3500 coverage artifact and matrix refresh.
- Added no new feature issues; no new classifier labels were needed.
